question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in bold in the following sentence.**

Her candid remarks impressed the Board of members.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Deceitful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the marked option:
 
 
• **Candid - **saying exactly what you think, genuine, etc.
 
• **Deceitful -** dishonest; trying to make somebody believe something that is not true.
